_purpose: #3374 R1 — the committed cost-bearing-surface baseline. HAND-OWNED, deliberately NOT written by scripts/generate_platform_model.py: the generator derives the live counts into model/platform_model.json's cost_surface plane, and tests/test_platform_model_drift.py exact-pins this file against them. A PR that grows a cost-bearing population (a new schedule, alarm, EMF namespace, secret, or budget-guard AI feature) must bump the matching count HERE, in the same diff — that hand edit is the ratchet's deliberate act. A shrink must ratchet the count down the same way, so the baseline can never rot above the estate.
_last_change: #3563 (2026-09-14): alarms 128 -> 129 — ONE alarm, 'swallowed-permission-denial', for the whole permission-denial class. 46 CloudWatch Logs MetricFilters (one per email/operational log group) all publish the SAME dimensionless metric LifePlatform/Lambda::SwallowedPermissionDenied, so the cost is ONE alarm ($0.10/mo) and not 46, and the custom metric itself publishes no datapoint while healthy — 'AccessDenied' appears in no healthy log line, the same should-never-happen property the #2654/#3563 token alarms have. Metric filters are not billed. This is deliberately NOT the level=ERROR filter fleet the 2026-09-05 forensic RCA rejected at $1.50-2.90/mo: that price is per DISTINCT metric name plus an alarm each, and collapsing N filters onto one metric makes the bill independent of N (tests/test_swallowed_denial_visibility_3563.py::test_every_filter_publishes_the_same_single_metric is the ratchet on that). Bought: a swallowed IAM denial anywhere in the email/checker family reaches the digest within the hour instead of the four weeks /api/status spent calling the Wednesday chronicle red while it shipped. No new Lambda, no schedule, no Bedrock, no EMF namespace.
